status: Completed failed diagnostic ablations; no engine or production shader patch adopted. Investigation stopped under the user's appearance-based quality direction.
scope: Private existing Linux runtime; ordinary mixed sky versus lookup-only scratch candidate. Temporary LD_PRELOAD records actual shader modules and draw/pipeline state; optional exact-byte-matched SPIR-V substitutions only in child validation process. Not timing or release acceptance.
findings: Read-only recorder reproduces native cloud changes on restoring the original pipeline, layout, viewport, scissor and camera push constants.

Seven NoContraction decorations in camera prelude do not make candidate/reference native cloud buffers exact. Scalar expansion of matrix and normalization arithmetic also fails and changes within an unchanged reference; no root cause is established.

SCREEN_UV.y and separate raw uv_interp.x/y bit probes remain fixed across eight captures each while reproducing known red cloud A/B states. X and Y were captured in separate diagnostic runs, not simultaneously. These probes do not establish all original-program intermediate arithmetic.

All four declared patch programs per patched run were verified in fragment modules used by actual sky draws. Raw-UV runs change one operand in each of two half-resolution modules; two full-resolution modules are forwarded byte-identically.

No arithmetic patch, recorded-ray texture or disabled display feature enters production. Original strict check failures remain recorded; user subsequently allows numerical and visual differences when clouds still look good.
